pages.text: Platforms float in the stratosphere, built as you come near: a steel deck with a mineral field and a $(l)vespene store$() — a glazed tank in the hull with its outlets in the deck under ventilation grates (a gas building goes on an outlet; emptied, it fills from the tank). Inside: lit passages, a hangar open to space, and dark tunnels. Wild troops of one race hold the deck, and more lurk in the dark.$(br2)Flyers go up into the stratosphere and down again by the $(l)Up/Down$() button (Y) of the command card.
